title: checkpoint.take
description: Takes a checkpoint of the working directory of the agent run in a pane, which a rewind can go back to (ADR-0050). A caller in a pane may name its own run (self), a run in a pane it spawned (children), or a run it launched whose pane has closed; a terminal outside every pane may name any run of this core. Once in 30 s per run. Waits for the take, at most 60 s. Needs hello version 2. Never returns a path.

pane.description: The pane of the run, the agent's pane that agent.launch opened.

new_bytes.description: Bytes read from files whose stat changed.

complete.description: False if a cap stopped the walk; a restore from it deletes nothing.

changed.description: Paths that differ from the run's launch checkpoint, 0 without one.
